android.desc:
Play this classic game anytime on the go. The widget can be placed on your home screen so you can play this simple logic puzzle anytime. Simply side the numbers to sort them until you have them all sorted.

Sizes available for play are: 3,3 4,4 and 5,5

show_hn.title: Show HN: Android Widget that is a puzzle game

quotes.text:
So this is just a simple sort/slide puzzle where you sort the numbers from 1-X to win. The part that I found interesting was that it was to show you could have simple games as widgets on your home screen. This is probably not how widgets should be used, but I found it pretty fun to work around issues that came up. For example, due to the system potentially shutting down the widget at anytime, the gamestate is saved to disk each move.

Feel free to check it out on GitHub (also has a gif):
https://github.com/ddxv/NumberPuzzle

Or download on Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thirdgate.numberpuzzle

If anyone else finds this interesting please feel free to reach out, I found making widgets pretty fun.
